value.rationale: The 2026 triangle theorem leaves the next natural centrally symmetric four-vertex class unsettled. The result gives a complete sharp global constant and a strict equality classification simultaneously over all shear angles, side-length ratios and base points, using the same direction-uniform chord model. This is a natural exact geometric inequality, not a special-parameter table; it distinguishes shape and sampling-law effects and supplies a benchmark for extension beyond parallelograms. The short proof does not diminish completeness of the extremal classification.
